name: Setup Docker Compose Testing Environment
description: Check Docker Compose environment, set up appropriate profiles, and run the application for testing with health checks and validation

task_steps.description: Verify Docker and Docker Compose are installed and running

prompt.template:
Check the Docker environment and verify prerequisites:

1. Verify Docker is installed and running:
   - Run: docker --version
   - Run: docker ps (to check Docker daemon is running)
   - If Docker is not running, provide clear error message

2. Verify Docker Compose is installed:
   - Run: docker-compose --version
   - Verify version is v2.x or higher

3. Check if any services are already running:
   - Run: docker-compose ps
   - List running containers and their status

4. Check Docker Compose configuration:
   - Verify docker-compose.yaml exists
   - Run: docker-compose config --profiles
   - List available profiles (stable, devbob, devbob-dev)

Provide a summary:
- ✅ Docker status
- ✅ Docker Compose status
- ✅ Available profiles
- ✅ Currently running services
- ⚠️  Any issues or warnings

task_steps.description: Stop any existing Docker Compose services to ensure clean start

prompt.template:
Stop any existing Docker Compose services:

1. Check if any services are running:
   - Run: docker-compose ps

2. If services are running, stop them gracefully:
   - Run: docker-compose --profile stable --profile devbob --profile devbob-dev down
   - Wait for services to stop (up to 30 seconds)

3. Verify all services are stopped:
   - Run: docker-compose ps
   - Should show no running services

4. Optional: Clean up volumes if requested:
   {{#if cleanVolumes}}
   - Run: docker-compose down -v
   - This will remove all volumes and data
   {{/if}}

Provide a summary:
- Services that were stopped
- Any errors or warnings
- Clean state confirmed

variables.name: cleanVolumes
variables.description: Whether to clean up volumes (WARNING: destroys data)

task_steps.description: Start stable backend services (redis, surreal, metabob-rpc-api-server)

prompt.template:
Start the stable backend services:

1. Start services with stable profile:
   - Run: docker-compose --profile stable up -d
   - This starts: redis, surreal, surrealist, metabob-rpc-api-server

2. Wait for services to be healthy:
   - Wait 10 seconds for services to initialize
   - Run: docker-compose ps
   - Check that all services show "running" or "healthy"

3. Verify each service:
   - Redis: docker-compose exec redis redis-cli ping (should return PONG)
   - SurrealDB: curl -f http://localhost:8000/health || echo "SurrealDB not ready"
   - API Server: curl -f http://localhost:8080/health || echo "API Server not ready"

4. Check logs for any errors:
   - Run: docker-compose logs --tail=50
   - Look for ERROR or FATAL messages

Provide a summary:
- ✅ Services started successfully
- ✅ Health check results
- ⚠️  Any warnings or issues
- 📊 Service ports and access URLs

task_steps.description: Start devbob testing container and verify connectivity

prompt.template:
Start the devbob testing container:

1. Start devbob with the appropriate profile:
   {{#if useDevProfile}}
   - Run: docker-compose --profile stable --profile devbob-dev up -d
   - This starts multiple devbob containers with mounted codebases
   {{else}}
   - Run: docker-compose --profile stable --profile devbob up -d
   - This starts a single clean devbob container
   {{/if}}

2. Wait for devbob to be ready:
   - Wait 5 seconds for initialization
   - Run: docker-compose ps devbob-clean
   - Check status is "running"

3. Verify ACP server is accessible:
   - Run: curl -f http://localhost:3000/health || echo "ACP not ready"
   - Expected: 200 OK response

4. Verify MCP server is accessible (if enabled):
   - Run: curl -f http://localhost:8082/health || echo "MCP not ready"
   - Expected: 200 OK response

5. Check devbob container logs:
   - Run: docker-compose logs devbob-clean --tail=30
   - Look for "ACP server listening" or similar startup message

Provide a summary:
- ✅ Devbob container status
- ✅ ACP server accessible at http://localhost:3000
- ✅ MCP server accessible at http://localhost:8082
- 📋 Ready for activity testing

variables.name: useDevProfile
variables.description: Use devbob-dev profile (mounted codebases) instead of clean devbob

task_steps.description: Run comprehensive health checks on all services

prompt.template:
Run comprehensive health checks on the Docker Compose environment:

1. Check all container statuses:
   - Run: docker-compose ps
   - Verify all expected containers are "Up" or "healthy"

2. Test backend connectivity:
   - Redis: docker-compose exec redis redis-cli ping
   - SurrealDB: curl -s http://localhost:8000/health
   - API Server: curl -s http://localhost:8080/health

3. Test devbob connectivity:
   - ACP Server: curl -s http://localhost:3000/health
   - MCP Server: curl -s http://localhost:8082/health (if enabled)

4. Check resource usage:
   - Run: docker stats --no-stream --format "table {{{{.Container}}}}\t{{{{.CPUPerc}}}}\t{{{{.MemUsage}}}}"
   - Verify no containers are using excessive resources

5. Check for any error logs:
   - Run: docker-compose logs --since=5m | grep -i error | head -20
   - Report any critical errors

6. Verify network connectivity between services:
   - Test that devbob can reach backend services
   - Run: docker-compose exec devbob-clean curl -s http://metabob-rpc-api-server:8080/health

7. Generate test report:
   - Provide a table of service statuses
   - List any warnings or issues
   - Confirm environment is ready for testing

Provide a comprehensive summary:
- ✅ All services healthy
- ✅ Network connectivity verified
- 📊 Resource usage normal
- 🚀 Environment ready for testing
- ⚠️  Any issues or warnings
